proof: 为什么不会错过另一种更好的顺序？窗口翻转的先后不影响结果，同一起点翻两次会抵消，所以最优解每个起点最多使用一次。从左到右归纳：所有可行解在更早起点上都必须与我们一致，而 i 处的值又唯一决定是否选 i。若必须翻却已放不下完整窗口，任何解都不可能成功；否则扫描完成后全为 1，且不存在更少的起点选择。
heading: 每次消费或补数后，边界如何改变？

proof: Could another order use fewer flips? Changing the order of these window flips does not change the result. Using one start twice cancels, so a minimum solution uses each start at most once. Inductively, every feasible solution must match our earlier start choices. The bit at i then uniquely decides whether start i is used. If a required window no longer fits, no solution exists. Otherwise the completed scan is all 1s, with no alternative that uses fewer starts.
